About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The Opportunity

SINGU provides property and facilities management technology for organisations operating complex, multi-site estates. Retail is a strategically important market for the business, spanning shopping centres, retail parks, high-street portfolios, supermarkets, hospitality and other distributed consumer environments.

We are seeking an experienced retail property, facilities or operations leader to become SINGU's senior market authority for retail and help build a differentiated, commercially successful position in the sector.

The Retail Market Principal will combine deep industry expertise, executive credibility and market leadership with clear commercial accountability. The role will help SINGU determine where it has the strongest right to win, create access to senior decision-makers, originate strategic opportunities, accelerate priority deals and strengthen SINGU's relevance across the retail property and facilities ecosystem.

This is not a conventional sales, pre-sales, product marketing or communications role. It is a senior, market-facing position for someone who understands retail property and operations at practitioner level and can translate that experience, credibility and network into measurable commercial impact.

Success will be measured not simply through market visibility or activity, but through SINGU's ability to create qualified pipeline, win strategic customers, expand existing relationships and establish a repeatable position within priority retail segments.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, you will have established a clear and credible retail go-to-market strategy, identifying the segments and use cases where SINGU can win disproportionately and building meaningful executive relationships across priority retail accounts.

You will have originated and influenced significant qualified pipeline, contributed demonstrably to both new-logo and expansion revenue, and developed repeatable retail propositions supported by clear customer evidence.

You will also have strengthened SINGU's network of retail customers and advocates, while materially increasing our credibility, relevance and market position within the retail property and facilities sector.

What You Will Own

Retail Market Strategy:

  • Define where SINGU has the strongest right to win across retail.

  • Shape our retail go-to-market strategy, priority segments, use cases and target accounts.

  • Maintain a strong point of view on the operational, regulatory and technology issues shaping retail estates.

  • Translate market insight into clear commercial and product priorities.

Executive Access and Market Development:

  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across retail property, facilities, operations, asset management and transformation.

  • Use your network and industry credibility to create access to strategic prospects and originate new opportunities.

  • Represent SINGU in executive forums, customer meetings, roundtables and selected industry events.

  • Build relationships across the wider retail ecosystem, including advisers, FM providers, managing agents and partners.

Strategic Accounts and Commercial Impact:

  • Work with Sales and Customer Success on a focused portfolio of priority retail accounts.

  • Help uncover strategic priorities, strengthen business cases and improve executive engagement.

  • Support selected opportunities where your involvement can materially increase SINGU's probability of winning.

description:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you’ll do

Drive high-impact security and infrastructure initiatives end-to-end. Lead complex, cross-functional programs spanning cloud infrastructure, platform security, identity and access management, detection and response, vulnerability management, and secure software delivery from problem definition through execution and sustained outcomes.

Own execution, planning, and program health. Be accountable for sequencing work, managing dependencies, tracking risk, and ensuring delivery of Sierra’s most critical security programs, with clear milestones and outcomes.

Help shape Sierra’s security strategy. Partner with security and engineering leadership to define priorities, investment areas, and execution plans that align risk reduction with platform growth, customer trust, and long-term scalability.

Build and strengthen security foundations. Drive programs that establish durable security primitives such as identity boundaries, access controls, logging and detection baselines, incident readiness, and secure defaults that future teams and features can confidently build on.

Translate ambiguity into clear execution. Decompose loosely defined security, risk, and compliance challenges particularly in emerging AI domains into structured programs, prioritized workstreams, and measurable outcomes.

Lead communication and alignment. Provide clear updates to leadership on program health, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs; surface issues early and drive cross-functional alignment.

Who you'll work with

Engineering: Infrastructure, Data Platform and Agent SDK engineers to shape technical requirements, manage dependencies, and deliver resilient systems.

Security & GRC: Security engineering, risk, compliance, and privacy partners to align on threat models, control strategy, audits, and risk management in a rapidly evolving AI landscape.

Product and GTM: Product, Agent Development, and Sales to operationalize security commitments and respond to sophisticated customer and regulator expectations.

Legal: On security terms, third-party risk, and contractual obligations.

Executive Leadership: Senior leaders who rely on you for clarity, prioritization, and confidence in Sierra’s security strategy and execution.

What you'll bring

Experience running security-focused technical programs in fast-growing SaaS or platform environments.

Strong technical fluency across cloud infrastructure, IAM, infrastructure as code, observability, secure CI/CD, and incident response.

Ability to execute through ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and keep teams moving.

Comfort operating in environments where things aren’t fully built yet and helping decide what needs to be built first.

Clear, concise communication with senior technical and business leaders.

A collaborative, pragmatic style with high ownership and high agency.

Even better...

Experience scaling security programs globally in AI-first or data-intensive SaaS environments.

Exposure to emerging AI risk, data governance, or agent and model-related security considerations.

Experience supporting security initiatives in public-sector, regulated and/or multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure).

Relevant security, cloud, AI or technical program management certifications.

Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, HIPAA)

Our values

Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

Life insurance and disability benefits

Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

Parental leave

Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers, we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior or Lead Security Engineer (Detection & Response) to build out the next generation of detection systems.

You'll sit within the team responsible for security across our IT and cloud environment, spanning AWS, identity, endpoints, SaaS and data center infrastructure. You'll own security monitoring and detection end-to-end: anticipating how our systems could be compromised, ensuring we have the right telemetry to see it, and building the detections and response workflows to act on it.

Think of it like SRE for security. We want someone who can answer questions like: Has this account been compromised? Is someone accessing AWS who shouldn't be? Has an attacker moved laterally through our network? How would we know?

You'll also lead investigations and incident response, automate repetitive security work, and work with IT and Engineering to fix the underlying problems you uncover.

Responsibilities

  • Own security monitoring and detection across AWS, identity, endpoints, SaaS, networks and data center environments

  • Develop and test incident response playbooks and continuously improve our response capability
  • Implement and enhance internal AI agents and security bots that assist with monitoring, investigations, reporting, and other security operation tasks.

Requirements

  • Significant hands-on experience in detection engineering, security engineering, incident response, threat hunting or a similar technical role
  • Strong understanding of cloud environments, ideally AWS, and how to monitor them for unauthorised or suspicious activity
  • Strong networking fundamentals and an understanding of how attackers move through networks and systems
  • Strong understanding of attacker tradecraft and the ability to turn it into useful, high-signal detections
  • Experience investigating real security incidents and taking ownership through to resolution
  • Strong scripting or programming skills, ideally Python, and a habit of automating repetitive work
  • Experience with security monitoring and response tooling such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR or equivalent

Strong candidates may also have experience with

  • Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
  • Biannual bonus scheme
  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs

Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Incident follow-through and continuous improvement. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

Your Qualifications

  • Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning;

  • Content moderation and AI guardrails: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.

  • Legal/safety work experience: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;

  • Collaborative mindset and communication: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;

You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Soft Skills

title: Content Manager
description:
About H:

H Company is a next-generation AI research and product company pioneering the future of autonomous, agentic AI. Founded to build intelligence that acts, H Company is creating the foundational infrastructure for autonomous AI systems that drive real-world outcomes across industries.

The Role

Today, H is known for its story: its founders, its funding rounds, its press. We want it to be known for its value. Content is how that shift happens, one piece at a time: the case study a CIO forwards to their COO, the white paper a board reads before a steering committee, the article an engineer shares because it is precise.

You will be our first Content Manager and reporting to the head of marketing. You'll own the global content strategy and production, hands in hands with the brand, lead gen and product marketing stakeholders, from thought leadership to customer proof.

Our brand stance is that of a pragmatic visionary: bold on vision, precise and evidence-led on capability. You'll write and edit in both registers, a bold "vision voice" and a precise "capability voice", so that every piece speaks the language of the boardroom and holds up to the scrutiny of a CTO/builder.

You'll work hand in hand with Product Marketing, Growth, Research, Sales, our FDE teams and Communications, and with our external agencies and freelancers.

What You'll Do

Build the content engine (Foundations)

  • Turn the new brand platform (positioning, tone of voice, messaging house) into a content strategy, an editorial line and a calendar by market (France, UK, US) and by audience (business C-levels and builders).

  • Own the core brand content: website copy, company narrative, brand and product pages, decks and event content, in line with the brand guidelines.

  • Set up the content system: templates, style guide, review and approval flows with Product, Research and Legal, and a library the whole GTM team can reuse.

Make value visible (Reputation)

  • Build our proof library: customer case studies, use-case stories and outcome numbers, working with Sales, FDE teams and customers.

  • Shift the content mix from founders and funding to product, value and customer outcomes.

  • Carry trust through proof: reliability, ownership, resilience and our research-first approach (we own our models, we are not a wrapper), explained without jargon.

Feed awareness and pipeline (Awareness)

  • Produce content for the brand plan: campaigns, flagship events, recurring PR moments and the brand side of our US launch.

  • Equip Growth with content that turns awareness into qualified relationships: ABM assets for target accounts, social selling content for our ambassadors, post-event follow-ups.

  • Work with Demand Generation on SEO/GEO so our content ranks in search and in AI answers.

Earn authority (Authority)

  • Run our thought leadership on the execution gap in enterprise AI and "AI that actually works".

  • Lead the content of our academic and expert references: the Institute Polytechnique de Paris partnership, the COMEX40 white paper, and research with analysts and consulting firms (Gartner, HBR, BCG/McKinsey).

  • Run the content of our "AI at work" Program: articles, interviews and the editorial behind its executive dinners.

Work across the team

  • Partner with Product Marketing, who own use-case families and sales enablement: you shape the stories, they own the battlecards.

  • Partner with Communications, who own corporate communications and executive social media: you supply the substance, they amplify it.

  • Brief and manage freelancers and agencies (writers, designers, video) within your content budget.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in content, editorial or content marketing, in B2B tech enterprise (AI, SaaS, cloud or enterprise software).

  • You have built a content strategy and an editorial calendar from scratch, and you can show what it delivered (pipeline, rankings, reach, reuse by Sales).

  • You write exceptionally well, and you edit others just as well: you can make a researcher's idea readable for a board and a CEO's vision precise enough for an engineer.

  • You have produced long-form content for enterprise decision-makers: white papers, case studies, research reports, thought-leadership articles.

  • You are curious about deep tech and comfortable interviewing researchers, engineers and customers to get the real story and the real numbers.

  • You are organized and autonomous: you run several pieces at once, manage freelancers, and ship on time.

  • Fluent English is required; French is a strong plus.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

  • You have written for an emerging category, where the words themselves were still being defined.

  • You have produced content for both European and US audiences and know how a story needs to flex from one market to the other.

  • You care about proof: case studies, customer voices and numbers matter more to you than slogans.

  • You know how content performs in search and in AI answers (SEO/GEO).

  • You are low ego and high ownership, and you like being the first member of a team that is being built.

Location

Paris/London, hybrid: 3 days a week on average in our office (8 rue Sainte-Cécile, 75009) or with customers. Occasional travel to London and the US.

What We Offer

  • Join the early days of one of Europe's most ambitious AI companies, and shape the stories the world reads about it.

  • Real ownership: the first content role in a Brand team being built, with direct access to our researchers, engineers and leadership.

  • A team of world-class researchers, engineers and operators who ship.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Benefits: health insurance, meal vouchers, transport

title: Senior AI Engineer - Freelance
description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

Baue eine dauerhafte Product-Security-Engineering-Funktion für die Shopware-Produkte auf. Product Security Engineering ist von der bestehenden SecOps- bzw. Information-Security-Funktion abgegrenzt. Die Funktion verantwortet die Ergebnisse im Bereich Product Security Engineering und das Betriebsmodell für diese Arbeit. Sie ersetzt weder die Governance durch InfoSec noch die Verantwortung der Engineering-Domänen, die Freigabe durch Quality oder Product Operations.


  • Entwickle und leite eine risikobasierte Product-Security-Roadmap für Commerce Core, Services und weitere Produktbereiche. Sorge für eine ausgewogene Gewichtung von Prävention, Erkennung, Incident-Bereitschaft und Behebung.

  • Verantworte das Modell für Eingang und Triage von Product-Security-Findings aus externen Meldungen, Bug-Bounty-Programmen, Penetrationstests, Dependency-Sicherheitshinweisen, internen Entdeckungen und Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen. Vereinbare Schweregrade und Reaktionsziele mit den Domänenverantwortlichen und InfoSec, leite jeden Vorgang an den zuständigen Code Owner weiter und mache die laufenden Reaktionsfristen sichtbar.

  • Arbeite selbst aktiv mit: Erstelle Threat Models für sicherheitskritische Änderungen, prüfe risikoreiche Designs, untersuche Schwachstellen und implementiere besonders wirksame Sicherheitskontrollen in gemeinsam genutzten Produktkomponenten oder entwickle sie gemeinsam mit anderen.

  • Etabliere wiederholbare Vorgehensweisen für sicheres Design, Sicherheitsreviews, Tests von Missbrauchsszenarien, Dependency- und Code-Scanning, die Offenlegung von Schwachstellen und Incident-Bereitschaft.

  • Koordiniere produktübergreifende Sicherheitsarbeit über eine vereinbarte Dokumentation: GHSA für Angaben zur Offenlegung, ein privates GitHub-Issue oder Epic für Fixes und Backports sowie eine Confluence-Seite zum Sicherheitsvorfall oder Release für Rollen, Entscheidungen, QA-Status und Kommunikationsbereitschaft. Nutze Slack für die operative Abstimmung und verlinke getroffene Entscheidungen zurück in die Dokumentation.

  • Weise gemeinsam mit den Engineering Leads jedem bestätigten Problem eine technisch verantwortliche Person und einen Fälligkeitstermin zu. Eskaliere blockierte Behebungen und verbleibende Risiken über die etablierten Entscheidungswege von Product, InfoSec und der Führungsebene.

  • Verbessere die Sicherheitsabdeckung für unterstützte Versionen und zugehörige Produkte, darunter das Security Plugin, Commercial-Komponenten, Services sowie relevante App- und Extension-Schnittstellen.

  • Leite die technische Aufarbeitung nach Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases. Überführe Ursachen in konkrete Präventionsmaßnahmen mit klarer Verantwortung, Tests, Tools oder Designänderungen und verfolge, ob diese Änderungen Wiederholungen reduzieren.

  • Arbeite mit InfoSec, Product Operations, Quality Operations, DevRel, Legal, Customer Support und der Product-Leitung an Entscheidungen zu Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Reaktionen, Releases und Kommunikation.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Verbesserung der Sicherheit produktiv eingesetzter Produkte.

  • Praktische Kenntnisse in der Anwendungssicherheit, insbesondere zu Authentifizierung, Autorisierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Datentrennung, API-Sicherheit, Umgang mit Zugangsdaten, sicheren Integrationen und gängigen Schwachstellenklassen.

title: Senior Security Engineering Consultant
description:
Nomios’ mission is to build a secure and connected future. Organisations across the globe depend on us to help secure and connect their digital infrastructures.

As part of our continued UK growth, we are expanding our Professional Services capability and seeking a Security Engineering Consultant to deliver specialist security engineering and operations consultancy across our customer base.

This is a hands-on technical role within the Security Operations domain, focused on helping customers improve and automate their SOC functions, tooling, and detection capabilities. You will work across a range of technologies and engagements, from SOAR and SIEM implementation through to vulnerability management, exposure management, and process automation.

Your role as Senior Security Engineering Consultant

The Security Engineering Consultant role sits within the Security Operations Team, working directly with the Nomios SOC Engineering team.

This is a senior, customer-facing Professional Services role within our Security Engineering function, focused on detection engineering and automation. You will lead the design and delivery of detection and response capabilities across SIEM, XDR and SOAR platforms. This includes building detection rules, developing automations, and creating operational playbooks that support effective SOC outcomes.

A key aspect of the role is ownership of the detection as code approach, ensuring detections and automations are developed, structured and delivered in a consistent and scalable way. Working directly with customers, you will define detection strategies, design use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, and guide improvements in visibility, coverage and response maturity. You will work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams, supplementing them with specialist expertise in detection engineering and automation, rather than focusing on platform deployment itself. 

The role combines hands-on engineering with advisory responsibilities, with a clear focus on delivering high-quality outcomes and enabling customers to operate and evolve their detection capabilities.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities of the role include:

Deliver

  • Design and deliver detection rulesets across SIEM and XDR platforms

  • Develop and tune detection logic using KQL or equivalent query languages

  • Design detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and real-world attack techniques

  • Map customer log sources to detection use cases to assess coverage and identify gaps

  • Design and implement SOAR automations, integrations and response workflows

  • Develop and document customer incident response playbooks aligned to detection outputs

  • Translate threat intelligence and operational learnings into improved detections and automations

  • Deliver detection as code pipelines, including structured use case development and versioning approaches

  • Produce clear technical and customer-facing deliverables, including detection strategies, use case catalogues and coverage assessments

Collaborate

  • Work directly with customers as a trusted technical consultant

  • Lead workshops covering detection engineering, use case design and SOC maturity

  • Guide customers on improving detection coverage and aligning to MITRE ATT&CK

  • Clearly explain detection strategies, gaps and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams to ensure smooth integration of delivered detections and automations

  • Support SOC teams by ensuring delivered outputs are practical, usable and aligned to operational workflows

Improve

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of detection use cases, playbooks and automation patterns

  • Support development of reusable detection content and delivery standards

  • Contribute to lab work, testing and validation of detection approaches

  • Identify gaps in telemetry, logging and enrichment, and provide recommendations to strengthen detection outcomes


Job Requirements
 

At Nomios, we’re looking for #smartpeople who bring #highenergy, curiosity and a strong desire to learn. If you're someone who enjoys working collaboratively, communicates clearly and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with SIEM engineering, including developing and tuning detection rules, with Microsoft Sentinel preferred 

  • Experience writing detection logic using KQL or similar query languages 

  • Proven experience designing and implementing SOAR automations and playbooks such as Logic Apps, Cortex XSOAR or similar 

  • Scripting and automation capability using Python, PowerShell or similar, including working with APIs 

  • Experience designing detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK 

  • Strong understanding of detection coverage and how log sources map to the attack lifecycle

  • Experience with XDR or EDR platforms such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike or Cortex 

  • Understanding of cloud environments, particularly Azure, and associated security telemetry 

  • Experience working in customer-facing or consultancy roles 

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly

Technical Competencies

  • SIEM and XDR platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Palo Alto XSIAM or XDR, CrowdStrike and SentinelOne 

  • SOAR development, including automation and playbook design using platforms such as Palo Alto XSOAR or similar 

  • Scripting and integration using Python, PowerShell or similar, including API-driven automation 

  • Detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, including use case design, ruleset development and coverage assessment 

  • Log source mapping and normalisation to support detection use cases 

  • Network Detection and Response technologies such as Vectra AI, Corelight or similar 

  • Cloud security and telemetry, particularly within Azure environments 

  • Threat intelligence integration and enrichment to support detection and response 

  • Development of customer playbooks and response workflows aligned to SOC operations 

  • General awareness of emerging technologies, including AI-driven security tooling and their application within detection and response

Job Specifics

  • Location: This is a hybrid role, while the role is primarily remote, typically 70% to 80% percent of the time, there will be a requirement to travel to customer sites and attend the Basingstoke office as required to support delivery, workshops and engagements.

    (free hot & cold drinks, breakfast items, snacks, lunches, and regular takeaway Fridays are provided to all staff in the office!).

  • Hours are full-time: Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm. There is no on-call requirement for this position.

Why would you choose to come and work with us?

You will be part of a collaborative engineering environment, working across a wide range of customer environments and technologies. The role offers exposure to real-world threats, modern detection approaches, and the opportunity to shape how Security Operations capabilities are designed and delivered.

Nomios offers a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, and industry-leading benefits, along with the opportunity to make a genuine impact on how we and our customers build and run Security Operations.

Nomios is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating and sustaining an environment in which everyone is provided with an equal opportunity to grow and develop, and no individual will be unjustly discriminated against. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination because of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion and belief, sex and sexual orientation.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Bally’s Intralot is a newly formed company established through the combination of Intralot and Bally’s International Interactive, positioning the group as a top iGaming operator and a leading global provider of lottery solutions.

Bally’s Intralot is uniquely positioned across digital online gaming markets, lottery, iLottery, and sports betting. Operating at the intersection of technology, regulation, and entertainment. Well, what about the team?

Join our AI Transformation team to create new capabilities and rethink how teams across Product and Technology work. Our programme aims to help teams ship faster, improve quality, reduce the effort and cost of delivery, build products that strengthen our competitive position, and develop our people’s skills. We turn promising ideas into working products and practices that teams can adopt and reuse across the business.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be empowered to identify opportunities, propose ideas and build new products, tools and ways of working. You will take ownership of your own initiatives, from a clear hypothesis and agreed success measures through experimentation, production delivery and learning. Alongside this, you will work with engineering teams to turn their prototypes into reliable production products, own shared transformation tooling, and showcase new approaches through demos, tech talks, workshops and pairing. This role combines the creativity to see what could be different with the engineering judgement and drive to make it happen.

So, what will you be doing?

  • Originate and build new capabilities: Proactively identify opportunities across Product and Technology, turn them into practical proposals, and build products, internal tools, automations and agents that create value. Own selected initiatives from discovery through delivery, working with stakeholders to connect each idea to a clear programme outcome.

  • Run experiments that lead to decisions: State the opportunity and hypothesis, then agree the success measure and threshold before building. Create the smallest useful experiment, use a feature flag or controlled rollout where appropriate, and measure against a control or baseline at an agreed review date. Use the evidence to scale, change or stop the work.

  • Take prototypes into production: Deliver your own successful experiments and partner with engineering teams to productionise theirs. Resolve architecture, integration, testing, security and operational gaps, agree production-readiness criteria, and work through release and handover with the teams that will own and operate the resulting products.

  • Improve how teams build software: Redesign planning, development, testing, review and delivery around the capabilities of AI. Build and trial approaches such as specification-driven development and agent-assisted workflows, then turn successful work into reusable skills, reference implementations, connectors and engineering patterns that teams can adapt.

  • Own shared transformation tooling: Build and maintain the programme’s shared applications, APIs, integrations and analytics on AWS, including the Radar and Tracker and connections to engineering and collaboration systems. Keep these services reliable, maintainable and useful to activity owners and programme leaders.

  • Champion practical AI engineering: Showcase emerging approaches and techniques through regular demos, tech talks, workshops, pairing and clear written guides. Share working examples, explain trade-offs and limitations, and turn successful experiments into practices that other teams can use.

  • Evaluate tools and approaches: Keep up with developments in AI engineering, test them against real team needs, and recommend adoption based on evidence. Consider quality, cost, security and portability, helping teams retain flexibility as tools, models and pricing change.

  • Embed quality and responsible use: Work with Platform, SRE, Cyber and governance colleagues to build evaluation, observability, access controls and appropriate human oversight into AI-enabled services and workflows. Help teams understand failure modes and make support, recovery and ownership arrangements clear.

  • Develop capability in others: Mentor graduate and less experienced engineers, and work with learning and enablement colleagues to address practical skills gaps. Build teams’ confidence and ability to maintain what they adopt.


And what will you need?

  • Software engineering and delivery: Strong Python or TypeScript skills and experience taking prototypes into production, including APIs, cloud deployment (preferably AWS), automated testing, CI/CD and observability.

  • Practical AI engineering: Experience building LLM applications, agents or automations, using AI coding tools effectively, and improving results through evals and error analysis. Familiarity with context, reusable skills and integrations through APIs or MCP.

  • Initiative and product judgement: Evidence of spotting opportunities, creating useful solutions without a fully defined brief, and owning delivery from idea to outcome.

  • Experimentation and evaluation: Ability to define hypotheses and success measures before building, run focused experiments against a baseline or control, and use evidence to decide what happens next.

  • Sound engineering judgement: Ability to balance quality, reliability, security and cost, evaluate AI behaviour, and choose maintainable solutions with appropriate data access and human oversight.

  • Technical evangelism and collaboration: Clear communication through demos, tech talks, workshops and written guides. Experience partnering with teams, mentoring engineers and helping others adopt effective practices.

What benefits will you get?  

  • 25 days annual leave, plus the bank holiday allowance.

  • Health insurance.

  • Volunteering days.

  • Home office allowance.

  • Wellness or Gym allowance.

  • Flexi-block policy allowing you to work abroad for up to four weeks a year. 

DNA / Values:

At Bally’s Intralot we are driven by a set of core values that we like to call our DNA. We strive to embody our DNA and keep them at the heart of everything we do!

We Win as One, we succeed together - across every location and every function. We collaborate openly, raise each other up, and share the wins. We're Powered by Curiosity, we ask questions, challenge assumptions and make space to learn and innovate. We have Fun with Purpose, we bring creativity, energy and joy to how we work and what we deliver, because when people enjoy what they do, the work is better for everyone. Our teams Embrace the Possibility, when opportunity appears, we act. When the unexpected hits, we adapt. We don’t wait for change - we move towards it. At Bally's Intralot, we Guard the Game, we protect what matters most,  fair play for our players, integrity for our partners, and accountability in everything we do.

Equal Opportunities
